clean_variants.code:
def backoff_delays(base, cap, attempts):
    # Double the delay after each failed attempt but never exceed the cap so
    # retries stay bounded.
    delay = base
    for _ in range(attempts):
        yield delay
        delay = min(delay * 2, cap)

The test-name exemption must not exempt ordinary long names
